title: Zero-Party Data Strategy 2026: Data Your Customers Give You
excerpt: Chrome kept third-party cookies, but signal loss is real. Here's how to build a zero-party data strategy your competitors can't copy in 2026.
metadesc: Google kept Chrome's third-party cookies, but signal loss is real. Learn what zero-party data is and 5 steps to collect and activate it in 2026.
featured_alt: Zero-party data strategy: 71% of consumers expect personalised interactions

alts.INFO_1: Timeline of third-party cookies: Safari blocks them in 2020, Firefox in 2022, Google keeps them in Chrome in 2024 and 2025 and retires most Privacy Sandbox APIs
alts.INFO_2: The data hierarchy: third-party, second-party, first-party and zero-party data compared
